title: The specified diagonal orientation charts and restriction comparisons
statement: In the finite setting [def-pur-conventions], retain the actual objects, maps and predicates of [lem-pur-affine-target-diagonal-dnc] and [def-pur-orientation-refinement-comparisons]. The data are the canonical source/normal section objects, rho, alpha, the unique normalized DNC delta, integration-normalized beta, their four-factor theta, and the exact Geometry, Chart, Compatible, Agrees and restricted predicates used by diagonal orientation refinement. All formulas are the unchanged original definitions; this node records their independent module so proof lemmas can import the data without importing the assembly theorem.
